facts.businessOwner: ProgramRollover owns a reviewed proposal with NextPeriodId and NextTypeIIPlanId, including an exact approved proposal version.
facts.reviseRule: The current aggregate permits Revise when status is proposed, approved, or rejected, provided period creation has not completed. Revision changes status back to proposed and advances version.
facts.sourceBoundaryRationale: The selected rationale says proposal/current approval and execution claim must coordinate to prevent the approved version changing while successors are created; successor creation acknowledgement belongs to recoverable process storage.
facts.missingTargetEvidence: No ProgramRollover execution process or rollover choreography rows are in the selected process/flow inventories.
facts.requiredOutcome: Create the exact selected successor period and TypeIIPlan, then record actual committed target-owner proofs against one immutable approved version; a process-side read/check alone must not race with revision.

boundary.instructions: Which coordination boundary best preserves the approved rollover version while independently owned successors are created?

criteria.aggregate_execution_claim_then_private_p: Add an owner-authorized execution claim/fence on ProgramRollover that pins the exact approved version and blocks later revisions; a private durable process then creates successors in their owning aggregates and records exact committed proofs.
criteria.private_process_claim_only: A private process can pin approval and create successor streams without a durable fence on ProgramRollover, while remaining safe against a concurrent revision.
criteria.approval_is_final_no_revision: Make approval itself permanently prohibit revision, then use a private process for successor creation and proof.
criteria.product_rule_unresolved: The supplied product facts do not decide whether approval can be revised or which owner must fence execution.

noul.instructions: Can a private process claim alone prevent a concurrent ProgramRollover revision from changing the approved version after the process checks it but before successor creation commits?

criteria.true: A selected atomic owner fence, reservation protocol or equivalent excludes revision across successor creation.
criteria.false: The process-side check can race with a ProgramRollover revision unless the aggregate durably fences the approved version.

coverage.instructions: Does the selected definitive set currently name the required execution claim, private process definition, successor target commands, and proof-based terminal step?

criteria.true: Each required claim/process/receiver/proof step is selected in the catalog.
criteria.false: At least one required execution boundary or causal flow is missing.
